summary: The figure shows trends in hepatitis B new infections and deaths from 2015 to 2030, comparing scenarios with new global health sector strategies versus no new actions. Under the strategy, both new infections and deaths decline significantly, reaching targets of 170,000 infections and 310,000 deaths by 2030. Without new actions, the number of new infections remains relatively stable and deaths increase slightly over time.
